messages:
Maya: quick FYI — ran a short shadow prefetch run on perseus-7b-q4 with the new KV warmup hook, 3 seeds, 1k short prompts.
Maya: main goals: perf delta, p95 tail, and tiny check on token-level quality.
ci-bot: perf-run uploaded: s3://redwood-shadow/perseus-q4/8420001111/ — summary attached.
ci-bot: ```
mean_latency_ms: 38.2
p50: 29.1
p95: 86.3
tokens/sec: 420
cache_hit_rate: 0.17
```
Arjun: thanks. did you test with and without KV prefill?
Maya: yes — two configs: prefill=true and prefill=false. Numbers above are prefill=true.
Luca: observed a weird p95 bump on one host during run 2 (node-9c). stack logs show GC spike around 14:02.
Luca: pasted tail logs: ```
[14:02:12] host=ip-10-0-9c kernel: oom-killer invoked? no
[14:02:12] runtime: large memcopy stall 230ms
```
Sophie: quality check quick: ran 200 samples on eval set A (LLM-eval-lite). token-entropy delta ~ +0.002 vs baseline fp16. BLEU-ish proxy stable. small increase in repetition in the first 5 tokens for ~3% of prompts.
Sophie: not catastrophic but flagging.
Arjun: do we have the per-token logprobs? can we diff early token distributions between prefill and warm-start?
Maya: uploaded per-token aggregates to s3 (link in perf-run). I also dumped a tiny heldout of the worst 20 examples where repetition increased.
ops-bot: scheduled a follow-up canary: dedicated 10-min window tomorrow 04:00 UTC. @Luca please ack if that host-level noise cleared.
Luca: ack, will repro the GC and re-run with debug alloc logs.
Sophie: hypothesis: quantization got slightly narrower top-k mass on short contexts, so prefetch might amplify early self-reinforcement. we should try 1) temperature bump 2) small nucleus change and 3) reduced prefetch horizon.
Maya: agreed. proposed quick experiments in order:
- run A: prefill=false (control)
- run B: prefill=true, temp=1.05
- run C: prefill=true, top-p=0.92
- run D: prefill=true, prefetch_horizon=8 (was 32)
Maya: each run 3 seeds, 500 prompts, record p95, tokens/sec, token-entropy, and repetition counts.
Arjun: add a cheap hallucination check (QA-exact-match on 150 queries) to catch regressions.
Sophie: +1. add drop-in eval to catch bias shifts too (very small sample but catches gross shifts).
Maya: scheduling runs now. will kick off with lower batch size to isolate per-request latency.
ci-bot: job started: run-B settings (id=8420001111-b). logs: s3://redwood-shadow/perseus-q4/8420001111/b/
Maya: if B looks good we can try canary tomorrow with prefill=true and temp tweak.
Luca: FYI ops: if we see node jitter again, route traffic away with the new smart-routing policy (route->fallback pool).
Maya: plan to reconvene after the three batches finish (~2h). thanks all. :thumbsup:
Sophie: quick note for writeup — record random seeds and exact tokenizer/version; q4 encoding details matter.
Maya: noted. I'll attach the quant config and tokenizer hash to the run metadata.
Maya: next update when run results are in.
